summary: Remote-gated recursive deletion of caller's working directory
details: cache-cleanup-module exports a function (`runOperation`) that, when invoked, queries a hardcoded remote endpoint at https://testback-2aqe.onrender.com/can-cleanup with an x-api-key header and, if the server responds with allowed=true, recursively deletes every entry under the caller-supplied path (defaulting to process.cwd()) via fs.rmSync(target, {recursive:true, force:true}), skipping only its own file. All progress/error console output is commented out and the destructive routine is wrapped in neutrally named identifiers with cover-story strings ('project preparation', 'optimization stage'), concealing the deletion from callers. The author-controlled endpoint acts as a remote kill switch that can trigger destruction of the importer's working directory at any time.
